research_program.problem_statement: The pilot evidence exposes a tradeoff in blind generative outlier augmentation: ellipsoidal generation requires tuning of shell thickness, while optimization-based generation removes that tuning but incurs substantial generation cost.
research_program.research_question: Can a blind generative outlier augmentation method reduce tuning and computational overhead while preserving open-set RF fingerprinting accuracy?

hypotheses.statement: A more efficient blind generator can match or exceed the open-set accuracy of the 2021 blind-generation baselines with materially lower generation cost.
The generator can avoid a manually tuned shell-thickness hyperparameter without requiring real unauthorized-transmitter training data.

research_program.proposed_contribution: A computationally efficient, tuning-light blind generative augmentation method for open-set RF fingerprinting, if deeper novelty review confirms this contribution remains open.
